name: StepHeroNFTs self-referral claimReferral()
summary: claimReferral(address) pays out referral commission accrued from the caller's own buyAsset() purchases with no check that the referral was independent, so a flash-loaned 1000 BNB self-referred purchase could be claimed back repeatedly.
